execution.phaseClaimNote: currentPhase is 'implement' with substate 'implemented'. The fix landed at commits e28be5814 and eeb2ac7cc. The benefit pack now carries earlyReductionRule.earliestClaimAge as a structured member with a resolving sourceRef and a locator, the engine reads ageYears from it and refuses below it quoting the pack's own figure rather than a literal, and the comparison surface refuses the single unpriceable candidate while leaving the priceable rows intact. The same commit repaired a temporal dead zone in scripts/selftest.mjs that had the repo gate at 3393 passed 1 failed; it now reports 3405 passed 0 failed. The boundary is asserted from both sides one month apart and six red-green probes were run through scripts/red-green-probe.sh, five discriminating and one recorded at exit 7 rather than discarded because it surfaced a real coverage fact. Every probe reported revert-verified against the committed blob and the tracked tree is clean. Fifteen of eighteen Definition of Done items are ticked with executed evidence; the three that are not carry an Uncertainty Declaration and none of them is missing behaviour. The two pack-contract questions design.md routes to the owner remain open and the uservalidation.md Human Acceptance Record is unrecorded, so this packet is not closed.
